answer: Require each agent to stake a small refundable bond tied to a verifiable work history before it can trade, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive rather than free. A new vertex in the trust graph earns reputation only after peers attest its completed tasks, like an onyx seal that cannot be forged by copying a name. Sybil swarms then face a real cost: they must either do useful work or stay silent, while honest agents keep trading, and no single sonnet of praise can substitute for that audited record.
